columns.name: Calculation_946600368870633479
columns.caption: Reached KOLs
columns.formula:
{ FIXED : COUNTD(
    IF NOT ISNULL([HCP mdm id]) AND [Target Type] = "True" AND [KOL Flag] = "Yes"
    THEN [HCP mdm id]
    END) 
}

columns.name: Calculation_946600369150234635
columns.caption: KOL Distribution CF
columns.formula:
CASE [Parameters].[Parameter 3]
WHEN "Tier" THEN [Tier]
when "Speciality" THEN [Specialty]
END

columns.name: Calculation_946600369151877132
columns.caption: Total KOLs
columns.formula:
COUNTD(
IF [KOL Flag]="Yes" then [Prescriber mdm id] END)

columns.name: Calculation_946600369155133454
columns.caption: Breakdown by CF
columns.formula:
IF [Parameters].[Parameter 4] = "Month" THEN
    LEFT(DATENAME('month',[Date]),3) + "'" + RIGHT(STR(YEAR([Date])),2)
ELSE
    "Q" + STR(DATEPART('quarter',[Date]))+"'"+ RIGHT(STR(YEAR([Date])),2)
END

columns.name: Calculation_946600369155682319
columns.caption: Duration Bucket
columns.formula:
IF [Duration] < 10 THEN "<10 min"
ELSEIF [Duration] <= 30 THEN "10-30 min"
ELSEIF [Duration] <= 60 THEN "30-60 min"
ELSE ">60 min"
END

columns.name: Calculation_946600369164791824
columns.caption: Target KOLs
columns.formula:
{FIXED : COUNTD(
    IF [KOL Flag]="Yes" AND [Target Type] = "True" 
    THEN [Prescriber mdm id] 
    END)
}

columns.name: Calculation_946600369184555025
columns.caption: Interaction Frequency
columns.formula: INT(ROUND({ FIXED : COUNT([HCP mdm id]) } / { FIXED : COUNTD([HCP mdm id]) }, 0))

columns.name: Calculation_2191001238756585480
columns.caption: # days for first response
columns.formula:
IF [Response Date] = 
    { FIXED [Request ID] : MIN([Response Date]) }
THEN
    DATEDIFF('day', [Create Date], [Response Date])
ELSE
    0
END

columns.name: Calculation_2191001238760943627
columns.caption: Time Bucket CF
columns.formula:
CASE [Parameters].[Parameter 1 1]
    WHEN "Month" THEN LEFT(DATENAME('month', [Create Date]),3) + "'" + RIGHT(STR(YEAR([Create Date])),2)
    WHEN "Quarter" THEN "Q" + STR(DATEPART('quarter', [Create Date])) + "'" + RIGHT(STR(YEAR([Create Date])),2)
END

columns.name: Calculation_2191001238765551628
columns.caption: First Response Bucket
columns.formula:
IF [Calculation_2191001238756585480] > 8 THEN "Over 8 Days"
ELSEIF [Calculation_2191001238756585480] <= 1 THEN "Within 1 Days"
ELSEIF [Calculation_2191001238756585480] <= 5 THEN "Within 5 Days"
ELSEIF [Calculation_2191001238756585480] <= 8 THEN "Within 8 Days"
END

columns.name: Calculation_2191001238769844238
columns.caption: Last Response Days
columns.formula:
IF [Status] = "Closed"
AND [Response Date] = { FIXED [Request ID] : MAX(
    IF [Status] = "Closed" THEN [Response Date] END
) }
THEN
    DATEDIFF('day', [Create Date], [Response Date])
ELSE
    0
END

columns.name: Calculation_2191001238769917967
columns.caption: Last Response Bucket
columns.formula:
IF [Calculation_2191001238769844238] <= 5 THEN "Within 5 Days"
ELSEIF [Calculation_2191001238769844238] <= 15 THEN "Within 15 Days"
ELSEIF [Calculation_2191001238769844238] <= 30 THEN "Within 30 Days"
ELSEIF [Calculation_2191001238769844238] > 30 THEN "Over 30 Days"
END

columns.name: Calculation_2191001238779916306
columns.caption: Created Date
columns.formula:
DATENAME('weekday', [Create Date]) + ", " +
DATENAME('month', [Create Date]) + " " +
STR(DAY([Create Date])) + ", " +
STR(YEAR([Create Date]))

columns.name: Calculation_2191001238779969555
columns.caption: Response Date
columns.formula:
DATENAME('weekday', [Response Date]) + ", " +
DATENAME('month', [Response Date]) + " " +
STR(DAY([Response Date])) + ", " +
STR(YEAR([Response Date]))
